title: Read Between the Wines Book Club
seo_title: Read Between the Wines Book Club in Ozark, MO
description: This is the December meeting of the Read Between the Wines Book Club, where the group discusses The Christmas Party by Mikayla Davids, works through discussion questions, and shares a suggested winter reading list. There are festive cocktails, holiday wine pairings, and a seasonal activity, and reservations are made by calling or signing up online. It takes place Tuesday, December 15, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, with regulars arriving at 5 PM for holiday treats and seats.
